title: Spartathlon Race Rules (official PDF dated 2022)
claims: The official rules PDF states that runners may receive physical help from supporters only at the listed checkpoints and that supporting bicycles or motorcycles are forbidden.

The rules state that a runner who abandons must hand in bib and chip, sign a withdrawal form at the spot or nearest checkpoint, and will be transported by an official car to Sparta and the hotel designated by the organising committee.
The rules define the finish as touching the base of the statue of King Leonidas within the time limit.
The rules forbid runners from entering a supporting vehicle to receive help and forbid support vehicles from stopping between checkpoints to assist.
The PDF is dated 2022; the official site still links it as the race-rules document, but the 2026 road book is the current checkpoint and service source for this page.
